text:
Maya (ML Eng): Quick ping — planning to onboard 'orchid-7b' (open) into the model-catalog. Need: owner, license vetting, perf profile, eval prompt set. Target: catalog READ-ONLY by next Tue. Who can own?

Priya (Legal): please send the license text + model weights source. If it's Apache-2-like, should be fine. Watch for any non-commercial clauses. Also need a third-party-deps list.

Sam (Product): Use-case will be chat summarization + embeddings fallback. We need both gen and embeddings artifacts. Embedding dim? Prefer 1536 to match current infra, but maybe 1024 if smaller.

Jonah (Runtime): I can do a perf baseline. What quant/config do you want? FP16 baseline + int8 candidate? Perf target: p95 <= 200ms at seq512 batch=1 on A10x (if that helps with prioritization). If not, tell me target and I'll run.

Nina (Onboarding): I'll take ingestion + model metadata. Need model files + license text. I can open an intake PR and wire CI.

Maya (ML Eng): linking model + license: https://models.example.org/orchid-7b (weights + metadata). License: https://models.example.org/orchid-7b/LICENSE ("Permissive-Orchid-1.0").

Priya (Legal): thanks — that looks non-standard. I'll do a compatibility pass and check for any export/usage restrictions. Expect comments by EOD tomorrow.

Jonah (Runtime): starting perf script; will try both fp16 and int8. Command I'm using:
```
./bench.sh --model orchid-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --quant fp16 && \
./bench.sh --model orchid-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --quant int8
```
I'll paste numbers here when done.

DevBot: ingest-job #432 queued by Nina. CI: model-file checksum OK, license file present.

Nina (Onboarding): opened intake PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/987 — added initial meta.yml, license, and a small README. Tagging reviewers @Maya (ML Eng) @Jonah (Runtime)

Sam (Product): for rollout, suggest marking as "canary" to Dedicated first, then Hosted after perf+eval pass. Also add model tags: [open-model, summarization, embeddings]. Who will write the model card?

Maya (ML Eng): I'll draft the model card. Can someone assemble a short eval prompt set (10-15 prompts) for summarization quality + embedding similarity? @Sam can you share product examples?

Sam (Product): will DM a prompt set this afternoon.

Priya (Legal): license passes basic check but will add a single comment on attribution text. I'll post on the PR.

Jonah (Runtime): perf run done — quick numbers: fp16 p95=185ms (seq512,b1), int8 p95=140ms but output bit noisier on longform. Uploading full bench CSV to the PR.

Maya (ML Eng): great, thanks Jonah. Nina — can you attach bench CSV + sample outputs to the PR so Legal/Product can review?

Nina (Onboarding): done — linked artifacts in PR.

DevBot: deploy-checklist created: [ingest -> perf -> eval -> canary rollout].

Maya (ML Eng): next actions: Priya finalize license comments on PR; Jonah and I will run eval harness on Sam's prompt set; Nina will prepare canary deployment config. Aim to cut canary Thursday.

Jonah (Runtime): I'll run eval tonight and post results. :rocket:

Sam (Product): thanks all — ping me if blockers.

Priya (Legal): will follow up on PR comments by tomorrow noon. :thumbsup:

Maya (ML Eng): closing the loop here — will update this thread when canary ready. Thanks everyone.
